papers.title: Survey of pediatric solid tumor care in economically underdeveloped regions of China.
papers.abstract: Despite advancements in pediatric oncology in China, disparities in the diagnosis and treatment of pediatric solid tumors persist, especially in economically underdeveloped regions. This study evaluates the landscape of pediatric solid tumor care in these areas, focusing on clinicians' knowledge, diagnostic and treatment capabilities, training needs, and perceived barriers to improving care quality. A cross-sectional survey was conducted among clinicians specializing in pediatric solid tumors in 14 economically underdeveloped provinces of China. The survey assessed clinicians' self-reported knowledge, diagnostic and treatment practices, training participation, and perceived barriers. Data were collected online and analyzed using descriptive statistics. A total of 259 responses were included. The majority of respondents were male (58.30%), with a median age of 39 and 11 years of pediatric experience. While most clinicians reported high theoretical knowledge (69.5%), 59.07% attended to fewer than 10 cases annually. Treatment capacities varied, with chemotherapy (94.56%) and surgery (92.05%) widely available, but limited access to radiotherapy (43.93%), targeted therapy (46.86%), immunotherapy (43.93%), and bone marrow transplantation (37.66%). Multidisciplinary team (MDT) implementation was insufficient, with 45.95% lacking MDTs. Most clinicians (96.13%) expressed a high need for further training, especially in clinical guidelines, disease recognition, and early screening. Key barriers included insufficient policy support (67.57%) and lack of standardized protocols (44.79%). Clinicians from underdeveloped regions face challenges like low case volumes, limited training, and resource constraints. Targeted interventions, including enhanced training, resource allocation, and policy support, are essential to improving care and outcomes for children with solid tumors in these regions.
papers.summary: 本研究針對中國14個經濟欠發達省份的259名小兒實體腫瘤專科醫師進行橫斷面調查，評估其知識水平、診療能力及面臨的障礙。結果顯示，雖然多數醫師具備高理論知識，但每年收治病例數偏低，且放療、標靶治療及免疫治療等進階療法可及性有限，多學科團隊（MDT）實施亦顯不足。此外，高達96.13%的醫師表達出強烈的進階培訓需求，而政策支持不足與缺乏標準化流程被認為是提升照護品質的主要障礙。
papers.significance: 此研究揭示了中國醫療資源區域間的不平等現象，具體呈現欠發達地區在兒童實體腫瘤診療上的資源匱乏與能力瓶頸。研究結果為衛生決策者提供了關鍵的實證基礎，強調透過加強專項培訓、優化醫療資源配置以及完善政策支持與標準化臨床指引，是縮小醫療落差、改善偏遠地區腫瘤兒童預後的迫切要務。

papers.title: Who measures the measurers: Closing the administrative accountability gap in non-profit acute care hospitals.
papers.abstract: Administrative costs in U.S. non-profit acute care hospitals are widely reported to be high and rising, yet hospital administrators are largely exempt from the productivity measurement. We introduce the Administrative Accountability Gap (AAG), the systematic exemption of administrative functions from the cost-per-output accountability criteria imposed on every other clinical workforce category and ask whether high administrative cost is structurally inevitable or a governance issue. We develop the AAG construct through principal-agent theory and operationalize it using the formally designated Administrative and General (A&G) cost center from CMS HCRIS Worksheet A. We analyzed 6,354 non-profit hospital-year observations across fiscal years 2021-2023. We complement the empirical analysis with an illustrative management accounting framework applied to a model hospital, with sensitivity analysis. Among 2,142 non-profit acute care hospitals in FY2023, median A&G cost was 17.9% of total cost (Ranged 12.4% (10th percentile) - 25.1% (90th percentile)). Non-profit A&G share (17.9%) differed significantly from for-profit (20.3%) and government (15.4%) hospitals (p < 0.001). Using an illustrative model, we show that $0.56 M-$3.64 M in possible avoidable annual costs attributable to a single administrative domain. Administrative cost intensity varies substantially among otherwise comparable non-profit hospitals, supporting the view that it reflects governance rather than necessity. Existing management accounting tools can close the AAG; we propose a framework and a research agenda for institutional validation. The principal barrier is the structural conflict of interest that allows administrators to design the measurement systems they are exempt from.
papers.summary: 本研究針對美國非營利急性期護理醫院提出了「行政問責缺口」（AAG）的概念，指出醫院行政人員長期以來被排除在產出成本績效衡量之外。研究分析2021至2023財年數據，發現2023年非營利醫院的行政與總務成本中位數佔總成本的17.9%，且與營利性及政府醫院存在顯著差異。透過管理會計模型分析，研究證實單一行政領域每年可能產生56萬至364萬美元的可避免成本，顯示行政成本差異源於治理問題而非結構必然性。
papers.significance: 此研究打破將高行政成本視為無法避免的迷思，首次系統性地揭示了醫療機構內部「行政人員制定衡量標準卻自身豁免」的利益衝突問題。透過提出具體的AAG框架與管理會計工具，該研究為醫院治理與績效評估提供了新研究方向，有助於監管機構和董事會強化對非營利醫院行政支出的監督，進而優化醫療資源配置。

papers.title: Perspectives on workplaces choices among physicians and nurses in peripheral hospitals.
papers.abstract: The shortage of healthcare professionals and the need for committed hospital workers is a global challenge, particularly in peripheral and rural areas, where workforce distribution disparities lead to unequal access to care. Various factors influence healthcare workers' choice of workplace, including external factors (residency location, economic incentives, family needs) and internal motivations such as sense of duty, perception of accomplishment, sense of belonging, social cohesiveness, professional and academic aspirations, and perceived opportunities. This descriptive cross-sectional study aimed to describe patterns of workplace considerations among physicians and nurses in two peripheral hospitals and to explore differences by profession and hospital context. During January-February 2023 a survey was conducted in two public hospitals in southern country district, comprising 42 questions across five domains: career opportunities, initial incentives, personal/family-based considerations, values, and demographics. Major incentives for workplace choices in peripheral hospitals include a sense of mission, professional enthusiasm and organizational values. Physicians prioritized unique specialties and academic engagement, while nurses emphasized professional teamwork and a sense of duty. Workers from the larger hospital scored accomplishment and prestige as significant influential factors. Choices of peripheral hospital workplaces are shaped by personal and professional factors, including a sense of mission, self-empowerment, governmental economic incentives and lifestyle considerations. These domains shape workplace preferences among workers in two peripheral hospitals, by professional, organizational and personal factors. These findings improve insight, generate hypotheses and inform locally tailored workforce policies, and may further contribute to national strategy.
papers.summary: 本研究透過2023年對兩家偏遠地區公立醫院的問卷調查，探討醫生與護理人員選擇工作地點的考量因素。結果顯示，使命感、專業熱情與組織價值是選擇偏遠醫院的主要動機。醫生較看重獨特專科與學術發展，護理人員則強調團隊合作與責任感；而規模較大醫院的員工更重視成就感與聲望。整體而言，個人價值觀、自我賦能、政府經濟激勵及生活方式等因素共同塑造了基層醫療人員的就職偏好。
papers.significance: 此研究揭示了影響偏遠地區醫療人力留任的內外部關鍵因素，有助於彌合城鄉醫療資源分配不均的差距。研究結果不僅能為衛生主管機關制定針對不同專業背景與醫療機構規模的「客製化」人力招募與留任政策提供實證基礎，更可進一步作為國家層級改善基層醫療人力配置與提升偏遠地區醫療可及性的重要戰略參考。

papers.title: A comparison of behavioral health service use among dually eligible, Medicaid-only, and Medicare-only beneficiaries.
papers.abstract: Dually eligible individuals, enrolled in both Medicare and Medicaid, have complex medical, social, and behavioral health needs and account for a disproportionate share of spending in both programs. They experience higher rates of poverty, disability, chronic conditions, and behavioral health disorders than Medicaid-only or Medicare-only beneficiaries, yet little is known about their behavioral health service utilization. To compare behavioral health (BH) service use among Medicaid-only, Medicare-only, and dually eligible beneficiaries. We conducted a retrospective analysis using claims data. Individuals with a BH diagnosis were classified into mutually exclusive coverage cohorts: Medicaid-only, Medicare-only, and dually eligible. Cohorts were further stratified into diagnostic groups: mental health (MH)-only, substance use disorder (SUD)-only, co-occurring MH/SUD. We identified 147,426,385 individuals enrolled in Medicaid and/or Medicare. 8.7% were dually eligible, 55.8% were Medicaid-only, and 35.5% were Medicare-only. Dually eligible beneficiaries had the highest prevalence of BH diagnoses. Dually eligible individuals had the highest rates of service utilization. Medicare-only beneficiaries had the lowest utilization rates. Medicaid-only beneficiaries showed intermediate levels of use. Within the dually eligible group, adults 18-54, males (for SUD), White beneficiaries, and urban residents had the highest utilization rates. Dually eligible individuals exhibit higher BH service utilization, as compared to Medicaid-only and Medicare -only beneficiaries, suggesting elevated treatment needs.
papers.summary: 本研究透過保險理賠資料進行回顧性分析，比較僅參加Medicaid、僅參加Medicare以及同時具備雙重資格（Dually eligible）受益人的行為健康（BH）服務使用情況。在1.47億名受訪者中，雙重資格者雖僅佔8.7%，但其行為健康診斷率與服務利用率皆為三組中最高；僅Medicare者利用率最低，僅Medicaid者則居中。在雙重資格群組中，18至54歲成人、物質濫用（SUD）診斷的男性、白人及城市居民的使用率最高。
papers.significance: 雙重資格者具有複雜的醫療與社會需求，且在聯邦醫療保險與醫療補助計畫中佔有極高的支出比例。此研究證實該群體對行為健康服務有顯著升高的實際需求與利用率，這對政策制定者優化醫療資源配置、設計針對性的雙重資格整合照護模式，以及有效控管公共醫療保險財務支出具有關鍵的參考價值。

papers.title: Violence prevention in primary care: a qualitative study of barriers and facilitators in general practice.
papers.abstract: Healthcare staff in primary care settings are increasingly exposed to verbal and physical aggression. Although violence prevention measures are available, implementation remains inconsistent. This study aimed to explore facilitators and barriers to the use of violence prevention strategies, with a particular focus on the roles of staff and leadership in general practice. We conducted a qualitative study involving semi-structured interviews with thirty physicians and medical assistants working in German general practices. The interview guide addressed perceptions of individual roles, leadership support, organisational structures, and existing preventive measures. We analysed the data using qualitative content analysis following Mayring. We found that the use of violence prevention strategies is influenced by interrelated individual, organisational, and leadership factors. Key facilitators included strong leadership engagement, clear communication of expectations, structured staff training, and individual competencies such as resilience and prior experience. Major barriers included high workload, staff shortages, limited financial and time resources, and a lack of formalised procedures. Leadership emerged as a central determinant: visible commitment, active involvement, and resource provision by practice leaders enhanced staff adherence and confidence. In contrast, insufficient leadership prioritisation hindered the systematic use of preventive measures. Effective violence prevention in general practice requires a multi-level approach integrating individual, organisational, and leadership dimensions. Strengthening leadership engagement, improving resource allocation, developing practical guidelines, and embedding training into routine workflows are important for overcoming existing barriers. Future efforts should prioritise the development of a proactive prevention culture, with leadership playing a pivotal role in enabling and supporting staff in managing patient aggression. Not applicable.
papers.summary: 本研究透過對德國30名基層醫療人員進行半結構式訪談，探討基層醫療中實施暴力預防策略的促進因素與障礙。研究發現，暴力預防策略的使用受個人、組織及領導層等多重交織因素影響。主要促進因素包括領導層的積極介入、明確的期望溝通、結構化的員工培訓以及個人抗壓能力；而主要障礙則涵蓋高工作負荷、人力短缺、資源受限及缺乏正式化程序。其中，領導層的承諾與資源提供被視為決定預防措施能否系統性落實的關鍵核心。
papers.significance: 此研究突顯了在基層醫療環境中，單靠個人的應對能力不足以有效防範醫療暴力，必須採取整合個人、組織與領導層的多層次干預策略。研究結果強調領導者在塑造「主動預防文化」中的樞紐角色，這為未來基層診所優化資源配置、制定實用指南並將培訓融入常規工作流程提供了重要的實證基礎，有助於提升醫療人員的安全感與整體醫療品質。

papers.title: Stimulus arousal level and savoring: An electrocortical investigation.
papers.abstract: Savoring is an effective positive emotion up-regulation strategy that has been shown to increase electrocortical and subjective response to positive and neutral pictures. In the emotion down-regulation literature, engaged emotion regulation strategies, which involve substantial processing of stimulus content, have been found to be better suited to low-arousing stimuli. Further, prior work had suggested that savoring might be less effective for neutral versus positive pictures (using ratings) and for pictures of cute animals compared to people - results that could be construed as evidence of savoring's reduced efficacy for high-arousing stimuli. Nonetheless, limitations observed for negative emotion down-regulation may not apply for positive emotion up-regulation, in which increased engagement with highly arousing stimulus content may facilitate rather than hinder emotion regulation goals. Here we set out to determine whether savoring would be moderated by stimulus arousal level - an inquiry with practical and theoretical implications. Participants (N = 90, after exclusions) were asked to savor or view high- and low-arousing positive pictures while EEG and picture ratings were recorded. Results showed that savoring increased the late positive potential (LPP), arousal and valence ratings to high- and low-arousing pictures. Bayesian results were consistent with the absence of an interaction between stimulus arousal level and condition for the LPP, but yielded anecdotal evidence that savoring might be more effective at increasing arousal ratings of high- versus low-arousing pictures. Therefore, there is no reliable evidence that savoring is compromised for high-arousing stimuli, in contrast with engaged strategies in the negative emotion down-regulation literature.
papers.summary: 本研究透過腦電圖（EEG）探討刺激物的喚醒水平是否會調節「品味」這種正向情緒上調策略的效果。90名受試者在觀看高喚醒與低喚醒的正向圖片時，分別進行品味或單純觀看。結果顯示，品味策略顯著增加了兩種圖片的晚期正向電位（LPP）、喚醒度與效價評分。貝葉斯分析結果證實LPP並未出現條件與喚醒水平的交互作用，且傾向支持品味在提升高喚醒圖片的喚醒評分上可能更為有效。總體而言，研究未發現品味策略在高喚醒刺激下會失效的可靠證據。
papers.significance: 此研究推翻了從負向情緒下調文獻中推論的假設，證實品味作為正向情緒上調策略，其有效性不受刺激物喚醒水平的限制。這不僅釐清了品味策略的適用邊界，也突顯了正向與負向情緒調節機制之間的潛在差異，為未來的情緒調節理論與實務應用（如提升幸福感干預）提供了重要的神經生理學依據。
